apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- fix(android): report uncaught JVM exceptions to Sentry (`8d4ce973`)
- feat(player): show badges for what is playing above the seek bar (`32c5ecae`)
- feat(core): derive stream badges from live playback and scope them to one pack (`022f4a31`)
- fix(player): pick one intro segment per kind by chapters then source consensus (`03e3a4af`)
- fix(ui): fill the whole input bar with the editable area (`3d4e1fec`)
- fix(core): register nuvioProfilePushPlan in sorted position so profile updates reach Nuvio (`b5a3bf32`)
- fix(ui): keep inline buttons beside text inputs in horizontal rows (`d6a57524`)
- fix(desktop): scroll the stream list with the mouse wheel (`528b6a4e`)
- fix(ui): keep the back button visible under the status bar while scrolling (`af438ef9`)
- feat(plugins): edit plugin preferences from userConfig fields (`dae7c288`)
- fix(settings): disconnect trackers in one tap and keep names while syncing (`ac17d5fd`)
- feat(desktop): sign in to trackers through the browser (`42f4ecdc`)
- fix(build): embed tracker client ids from .env (`b5755ba0`)
